proposition: MK's survey of the letters finds frequent dealings with Timurid amirs and a particularly close relationship with Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh, plus friendly relations with leading Sufis of Iran.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to amirs, Bāysunghur and Sufi shaykhs
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
